notes.title: Vortex Attack update to 1.0.6
notes.notes:
Some minor code and text tweaks.

- [b]Lumergyphobia[/b] achievement [u]has been updated[/u].
- Achievement: "[b]Complete the game 3P[/b]" [i]has been removed[/i].
- Achievement: "[b]Kill a boss in less than 30 secs[/b]" [i]has been removed[/i].

If you encounter any more issues let us know. We will definitely fix them!

notes.title: Vortex Attack EX update v1.0.3
notes.notes:
We released the game 2 weeks ago. We found out issues and we have fixed them. Here is a nice list.

- Music loops have been fixed.
- New audio Effects have been added.
- MORE LUMERGY. 
.... Unless you are playing on Easy mode, you will start getting again all the massive amount of lumergy that were present in Vortex Attack 1. 
- MORE COMBOS.
- Better gameplay balance.
- A much better introductory tutorial for Sector 1.
- Game fixes, very rare boss fights crashes.
- EASY and EXPERT buttons are more visible now. But expert will appear after completing the game once.
More points for Arcade and Expert, we appreciate they are less stages and harder levels. Thus, completing the game should give more points in Arcade or Expert than easier levels.
- More level types
- All asteroids can be destroyed now.
- Bosses have been tweaked for a better experience.
- Played death will leave some powerups floating for a short period of time.
- Fixed micro freeze after bonus levels.
- Fixed 'game over' showing an in game frame right before returning to menu.
- Stat texts are a bit smaller.
- How to play texts are smaller now.

And there are many more really small tweaks that aren't worth mentioning.

Enjoy the update!
